title: Documentation for ResourceSaver Class
key_points: ResourceSaver is a singleton for saving resources to the filesystem.
It uses ResourceFormatSavers to save resource data in various formats.
ResourceSaver provides methods like add_resource_format_saver, get_recognized_extensions, get_resource_id_for_path and remove_resource_format_saver
The class also includes enumerations like SaverFlags for specifying the save behavior.
limitations: This is a documentation file and not intended for direct use in code.
It assumes basic familiarity with Godot engine's classes, resources and concepts.
asserts: ResourceSaver is a central class for managing resource saving operations in the Godot engine.
